# FastHTML

> Python と HTMX を組み合わせ、HTML ファーストのアプローチで Web アプリを素早く構築したい開発者向けに、シンプルな記法で完全な Web アプリケーションを提供するフレームワーク。

## Guide

- [Contributor Covenant Code of Conduct](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/fasthtml/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md): In the interest of fostering an open and welcoming environment, we as contributors and maintainers pledge to make participation in our project and our community a harassment-free experience for everyone, regardless of age, body size, disability, ethnicity, gender identity and expression, level of experience, education, socio-economic status, nationality, personal appearance, race, religion, or sexual identity and orientation.
